source_title: Hero Destini 110 Classique Edition launched at Rs 76,400 - Autocar India
source_excerpt:
Hero first launched the Destini 110 in 2025 as its third 110cc scooter after the Xoom (110) and Pleasure+ XTEC. More than a year later, the brand has introduced a new cosmetic variant for it, called the Classique Edition, in time for the upcoming festive season.
Retains the 110.9cc engine that makes 8.2hp and 8.7Nm
Gets distinctive styling elements and colour options
Hero Destini 110 Classique Edition: What’s different?
Gets exclusive colours and dual-tone styling elements
The Destini 110 has two variants, VX and ZX. The Classique Edition is based on the VX, and as such, it has a drum brake at the front instead of the ZX’s disc. Hero has left the scooter mechanically untouched, which means it sticks to the 110.9cc engine making 8.2hp at 7,250rpm and 8.7Nm at 5,750rpm, as well as 12-inch wheels at both ends.
What sets this variant apart is the distinctive styling. There are three exclusive colour choices, with two inner panel colours. The silver and grey colours have brown inner panels, and the brown colour gets contrasting black inner panels instead. Colour-matched mirrors, an exclusive 3D emblem and stripes along the side of the scooter complete the look.
Hero has priced the Classique Edition at Rs 76,400, a premium of Rs 1,400 over the VX. The top ZX variant still sits at a considerably higher Rs 83,800, and Hero’s website now lists it in only a blue shade. The Classique Edition is already listed on the manufacturer’s Indian website for purchase and is available at its showrooms across the country.
